blind_spots.blind_spot: Public LinkedIn profile still describes an unrelated VPN-detection product, not the current Alt-PNT business
blind_spots.operator_reality: Not a product-engineering blind spot but a resourcing one: a 4-9 person team whose most-viewed public profile misrepresents what they actually build signals thin BD/marketing bandwidth exactly when TACFI's matching-investment clock is running — advocacy and capture work compete with core engineering for the same tiny headcount.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The company appears to have pivoted from commercial VPN/geolocation detection to Alt-PNT and never updated LinkedIn to match, likely because engineering effort went into the SBIR/TACFI technical work instead.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Luminous Cyber has invented machine learning based, credible, real-time VPN detection and geolocation that works without IP addresses, software installs or access to user data.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Position accuracy depends on Mobile Ad-Hoc Mesh Network density, which is itself vulnerable to the jamming that denies GPS in the first place
blind_spots.operator_reality: TDOA multilateration needs enough networked reference nodes in range to compute a fix; in a fully contested RF environment (not just GPS-denied but comms-denied), the same adversary that jams GPS could degrade the mesh LIS depends on, creating a second point of failure the marketing doesn't address.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The SBIR abstract sells LIS as the alternative to a single point of failure (GPS) without examining whether its own network dependency reintroduces one under the same threat model.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: LIS combines state of the art Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA) location determination algorithms... works hand in glove with Mobile Ad-Hoc Mesh Networks

blind_spots.blind_spot: Fluent in MOSA/SOSA/CMOSS technical standards but silent on ATO/RMF/CMMC accreditation
blind_spots.operator_reality: Conforming to an open-systems architecture standard is a technical interoperability question; getting onto a government network or fielded platform still requires a separate ATO/RMF package — a team this deep in standards-speak but silent on accreditation risks assuming standards conformance substitutes for the paperwork gate that actually determines fielding timeline.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Founders' expertise (per their own bio) is PNT, networking, security, and ML — deep technical domain knowledge, with no visible compliance/ISSO function called out anywhere in 1704 words of site copy.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Designed for MOSA environments, compatible with SOSA-aligned sensor...and supports integration into CMOSS-style modular subsystem frameworks.

opener_hook: Your March 2026 AFWERX TACFI required $2M in matching strategic investment on top of the government award — worth comparing notes on what actually closes the gap from TACFI to a program of record before that private capital runs out.
what_they_do: Builds resilient alternative Position, Navigation, and Timing (Alt-PNT) infrastructure — a Temporal Resilience Engine that preserves accurate timing and location for navigation and mission systems when GPS is jammed, spoofed, or unavailable.
